content.text:
The evidence is clear. Looking at the Core_bottom zone (Zone_F2_Z01) cooling setpoint stream:
- Before mid-June 2018: occupied 24.0 °C (06–21h), unoccupied/limit 26.7 °C, ramp 04-05h
- From June 15 2018 onward: occupied 23.0 °C, unoccupied/limit 25.7 °C, ramp 04-05h

Both the occupied plateau AND the unoccupied setpoint/limit shifted down by ~1 °C uniformly, with the same shape and same hours. Other core zones (F2_Z02, F2_Z03, F3_Z01, F2_Z08) had zero change.

A uniform shift of every period of the setpoint schedule (occupied AND unoccupied) with unchanged schedule hours is the signature of a **schedule change** — a controller offset or local override would only alter the active/occupied portion, not the unoccupied limit value.
